pairs: Best way to defrost a refrigerator freezer?

To defrost a refrigerator freezer, remove all food items and place them in a cooler with ice. Turn off the power to the refrigerator and open the door to allow the cold air to escape. This process can take several hours. Once the freezer is completely defrosted, clean it out and dry it thoroughly before placing the food back inside. If you're in a hurry, use a hairdryer on the cool setting to speed up the defrosting process, but keep it at least 12 inches away from the freezer to prevent melting the plastic or causing a fire hazard. Be cautious when using a hairdryer and never leave it unattended.
